what_this_is: THE ROUTING LAYER: for each TransformFit artifact type, maps the artifact to which gates run on it. Tier-1 gates are BUILT, mechanical, fail-closed (GREEN/RED only). Tier-2 (adversarial teardown vs named-gold) and Tier-3 (coach/buyer panel + metric trace) are DEFINED now as future HUMAN-GATE-ONLY RECORDED-PENDING gates — never auto-green, never blocking in this mission (built once gold is calibrated in M3+). Mirrors rig-design-studio/gtm/bridge.json + gate-shared.mjs (the anti-fake-green law: a human-gate-only gate may NEVER emit GREEN).

coach_buyer_panel.note: DEFINED now, BUILT in a later mission. Marcus/David/Jordan persona panel + coach-presence check (>=1 specific observation + forward hook + identity tie) + the metric trace (does it move Week-2 activation?). Never auto-green; RECORDED-PENDING until a human signs the verdict under the DUAL GATE.

ship_law: A TransformFit artifact ships ONLY on a hard-AND of the BUILT mechanical Tier-1 gates that apply to its type (each GREEN, one RED blocks ship) AND a sealed ProofPacket (proof-or-it-didn't-happen). The future HUMAN-GATE-ONLY members (adversarial_teardown, coach_buyer_panel) are DEFINED as RECORDED-PENDING — they are neither auto-greened nor fatally blocking in this mission; at runtime the ship-gate logs them as RECORDED-PENDING/future. Maker != grader. Mechanical RED blocks ship; human members are signed, not code-checked.
